item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #SLPRSD
Issued at 11:30 PM 13 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Sorsogon(Barcelona, Bulusan, Irosin, Bulan, Matnog, SantaMagdalena), #NorthernSamar(SanRoque, Mondragon, Allen, Lavezares, Rosario, SanJose, Biri, Capul, SanAntonio, Victoria), #CamarinesSur(Buhi, Sagñay, IrigaCity, Bato, Balatan, Nabua, SanJose, Presentacion, Caramoan, Garchitorena, Lagonoy, Siruma, Goa, Tigaon, Tinambac, Ocampo, Pili, Bula, Baao, Minalabac, Magarao, Calabanga, Bombon), #Catanduanes(SanAndres, Virac, Bato, Baras, Caramoran), #CamarinesNorte(Mercedes, Daet, Talisay, Vinzons and Basud) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Albay, #Sorsogon(Donsol, Pilar, Castilla, CityOfSorsogon, Gubat, Casiguran, Juban, Magallanes, PrietoDiaz), #NorthernSamar(SilvinoLobos, LasNavas, Catubig, Pambujan, Laoang, Palapag, Mapanas, Gamay and Lapinig) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
